topic: pack liquids in a carry-on under airport security rules
core_question: How do I pack liquids in my carry-on bag so they're allowed through airport security? (secondary: How do I replace old, streaking windshield wiper blades on a car?)
answer_summary: Put liquids, gels, and aerosols in containers of 3.4 ounces (100ml) or less, and fit all of them into a single quart-sized clear resealable bag, which must be removed and screened separately at the checkpoint.; after the topic shift: Lift the wiper arm off the windshield, press the small release tab to unclip the old blade, slide it off, and slide/snap on the correctly-sized new blade until it clicks into place.
persona: skeptical and testy; using casual slang
